profile.name: Zaber电动定位台
profile.description: 这是一类可通过串行 ASCII 协议控制的电动定位设备，通常为单轴或多轴位移台。设备可执行回零、绝对位移、相对位移、恒速运动和停止，适用于实验室中的光学元件、样品或探针的精密定位、扫描和对准。
profile.description_en: This is a motorized positioning device, typically a single-axis or multi-axis stage, controlled over a serial ASCII protocol. It supports homing, absolute moves, relative moves, constant-velocity motion, and stopping, and is used in laboratories for precise positioning, scanning, and alignment of optics, samples, or probes.
